remarks: Discover the perfect blend of urban energy and suburban tranquility in this spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom ranch-style condo at the acclaimed Adams Mill River House. Unit 112 offers a unique lifestyle advantage: a private walk-out patio overlooking the serene gazebo garden-giving the residence a "private entrance" feel and the perfect spot for your morning coffee or an evening unwind.  Inside, the thoughtful layout features an open-concept living area that flows seamlessly from the kitchen, which comes equipped with granite countertops. Both bedrooms are oversized retreats, each featuring a generous walk-in closet for ample storage. The primary suite serves as a true sanctuary with its own full bath, while the in-unit laundry adds essential everyday convenience. A standout feature of this home is the two reserved spaces in the secure underground garage-a rare and highly coveted perk in downtown Stamford. Residents also enjoy premium building amenities, including a fitness center, Amazon package lockers, and an outdoor grilling area. Positioned in the heart of it all, you are just 4 minutes from I-95, the Stamford Train Station, and the vibrant dining and nightlife of Bedford Street and Landmark Square. Whether you're a commuter or a local explorer, this location makes it easy to enjoy the best of Stamford.
